description: Source code implementing ASN.1 structures and methods for E1AP private information elements, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Represents a choice between local and global private IE IDs with serialization and JSON conversion methods.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for ASN.1 sequence of private IE fields, including pack/unpack and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for individual private IE container items, supporting pack/unpack and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specified option.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to local type and returns reference to c.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to global type.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into bit_ref or cbit_ref.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from bit_ref or cbit_ref.
